decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development by reason of its size, scale and nature of activity will cause unacceptable noise and disturbance resulting in a detrimental impact on the residential amenity of neighbouring properties and is thereby contrary to policies ENV B-1.1 (New Development), and C.3.4(Doctors and Dentists Surgeries) of the Unitary Development Plan and ENV B-1.1 (New Development), C.3.2 (New or Extended Health Facilities) and C.3.4  (Doctors and Dentists surgeries) of the revised deposit Unitary development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development will result in the loss of a residential unit and is thereby contrary to H.2.1 ( Presumption against loss of residential) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan and H.3.1 (Presumption against loss of residential) of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan.
description: Change of use at 524 from residential to doctors surgery and demolition of existing single storey rear extension at 524 and the erection of a single storey rear extension to 522 & 524, and the installation of new access and parking of site.
